title: Chapter 308 General Xie Xiaofeng
content:
Chapter 308 General Xie Xiaofeng

He held a mountain-splitting axe in his hand, jumped and chopped, and went straight to the wolf's head.

But the bloodthirsty demon wolf glanced at it contemptuously, and spit out a thunder bead, the size of a fist, shining with arcs of electricity.

Lin Dabiao didn't want to get hurt, so he used the door-sized axe as a shield to block the thunder bead.

But the axe was corroded by lightning, and the lightning flashed. He couldn't stop shaking, and fell directly from mid-air, spitting blood and being seriously injured.

Fortunately, Gong Zheng was quick-witted and quickly blocked in front of him, which allowed him to avoid the second attack of the bloodthirsty demon wolf.

Lin Xiaodong got a chance to breathe, and quickly killed the skeleton generals around him.

Wang Shuo kept an eye on Gong Zheng's situation at all times. If he was defeated, he had to save his life, although he had many ways to save his life, such as skills such as life feeding.

But Wang Shuo was still a little worried, and gave him two drops of water of life. As long as he was not killed instantly, he could be saved.

The balance of the battle gradually tilted towards the human side.

"Awoo!"

The bloodthirsty demon wolf roared.

At one time, a large number of undead rushed over. Although they were not military generals, they also caused great trouble to Wang Shuo and others. If the battle dragged on like this, it would be disadvantageous for humans.

Humans need to consume physical and mental strength, while the endurance of the undead is almost unlimited. At the same time, most of them do not need to consume mental strength, just chop and it's over.

Lin Xiaodong looked at the changes in the battle situation and gritted his teeth and used a group recovery scroll.

The health of the humans near the lord's mansion was quickly restored, and their physical and mental strength were also quickly restored.

The battle fell into a stalemate.

After killing a high-level military general skeleton, Lin Xiaodong immediately joined the battle against the bloodthirsty demon wolf.

After all, although these two warriors were able to delay the bloodthirsty demon wolf, they were obviously at a disadvantage, and it was only a matter of time before they were defeated.

As the undead army gradually decreased, the bloodthirsty demon wolf also began to become irritable.

"Awoo!"

With a call, a humanoid undead beast over 10 meters in size came towards the core battlefield from a distance.

This monster was obviously made up of multiple skeletons, and countless human skulls were embedded in its bones.

It looked ferocious and terrifying.

He kicked down the house that blocked his way with one kick, and all kinds of wooden beams and tiles flew everywhere.

When Wang Shuo and others saw this, they were shocked.

A bloodthirsty demon wolf was so difficult to deal with, and with a terrible skeleton monster, everyone's heart was once again covered with a shadow.

A hellhound knight who stepped forward to stop him was trampled into meat paste by him.

Wang Shuo's eyes were burning with fire.

No one could stop this monster now.

Everyone couldn't help but show a look of fear in their eyes.

What to do?

Lin Xiaodong was also shocked. He didn't expect the undead to have such a back-up.

The message to Hedong County for help had been sent as early as the moment the city was broken.

But the current situation in Hedong County is definitely very difficult.

But he has no choice. If he doesn't send high-level combat forces, he will definitely not be able to defend here.

Maybe his call was answered.

In the teleportation array, a white light flashed.

A swordsman holding a long sword and wearing a white robe walked out of the teleportation array.

With a casual sword, he cut off the head of a nearby skeleton warrior, although the damage displayed was only "-2300".

But after suffering fatal damage, the skeleton warrior fell down and never got up again.

Wang Shuo carefully checked the information of this person.

[Xie Xiaofeng (junior warrior)]

[Profession: Swordsman]

[Level: Level 55]

[Attack power: 1800]

[Defense power: 1200]

[Health value: 10000]

Wang Shuo could only see this information, but it was enough to shock him.
